question: What is the role of NADPH in photosynthesis?
answer: NADPH is produced in the light-dependent reactions of photosynthesis and is used in the Calvin cycle to reduce 3-phosphoglycerate (3-PGA) into glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate (G3P).
